transcript: y'all y'all I don't think you understand how much I am freaking out about this right now not only are we getting bat boy for the Fall Gala not only are we getting bat boy for Halloween for the Fall Gala we are getting bat boy directed by Alex Timbers I don't think you realize how freaking excited I am for this in addition to Bat Boy which I will be freaking out about until I'm seated in that theater we also have high spirits directed by Jessica Stone are you kidding me Wild Party is back however we do have a new director with Lili-Ann brown added to the project that I'm very excited about I saw her production of ain’t no Mo at Woolly Mammoth in DC she's done a lot of work in Chicago finishing off the season with the production of La Cage aux Folles which I'm not gonna lie I was not excited about Until I saw it was directed by Robert O'hara starring Billy Porter and is going to have an all black cast and I'm I'm sold I'm sold I cannot wait to see what vision Robert O'hara brings to the piece every single one of these shows is having a two week run which I could not be more excited about and every single New York City centre show has access tickets available at a discounted rate if you are under the age of 40 you just have to sign up for the access program and they send you emails with the discount code to get tickets to every single one of these shows at an affordable price if you have a little bit more money I do recommend subscribing I was a subscriber for a few years and I really love it because you get the same seat every time it automatically renews if you want and new subscriptions for the encore series which is just the bottom three shows start at the end of August Bat Boy is the gala performance so that does come separately and tickets for that go on sale for members on June 23rd and for the general public on June 24th I don't think I don't think I'm ever gonna get over Alex Timbers Bat Boy I I have dreamed of productions like that
